WITH telescope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    COUNT(*) as telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count FROM telescopes
),
shares AS (
  SELECT 
    tc.observstation,
    tc.telescope_count,
    CAST(tc.telescope_count AS FLOAT) / t.total_count as share
  FROM telescope_counts tc
  CROSS JOIN total t
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    s.observstation,
    s.telescope_count,
    s.share,
    a.avg_val
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_val
)
SELECT 
  SUM(telescope_count) as combined_telescope_count,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - avg_val) as average_excess
FROM above_avg
